items.wording: Generally speaking, would you say that most people can be trusted or that you can't be too careful in dealing with people? Where would you place yourself on this scale, where 0 means you can't be too careful, and 10 means most people can be trusted.
On a scale of 0 to 10, how much do you personally trust each of the following institutions? 0 means you do not trust an institution at all, and 10 means you trust it completely. America's courts.
When looking for news or information about political matters online, how often, if at all, do you: Try to confirm information you find by searching online for another source?

We are interested in how people are getting along financially these days. So far as you and your family are concerned, would you say that you are pretty well satisfied with your present financial situation, more or less satisfied, or not satisfied at all?
During the last few years, has your financial situation been getting better, worse, or has it stayed the same?
Compared with American families in general, would you say your family income is far below average, below average, average, above average, or far above average?
If you were asked to use one of four names for your social class, which would you say you belong in: the lower class, the working class, the middle class, or the upper class?
What do you think about the state of the economy these days in the United States?
Taken all together, how would you say things are these days--would you say that you are very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy?
In general, do you find life exciting, pretty routine, or dull?
Please select the answer that comes closest to how often you do the following: Spend a social evening with friends who live outside the neighborhood?
How often do you spend a social evening with relatives?
In your present or most recent job, have you ever done any of the following because of your responsibilities to members of your family? Cut back on your work?
Family life often suffers because men concentrate too much on their work.

Here are some statements about technology. Technology includes all kinds of machinery, equipment, digital devices, and software. How much do you agree or disagree with each of these statements? Technology makes our lives easier.

Here are some statements about technology. Technology includes all kinds of machinery, equipment, digital devices, and software. How much do you agree or disagree with each of these statements? Overall, technology does more harm than good.

The next questions deal with robots and artificial intelligence. 'Artificial intelligence' is the ability of a robot or computer to perform tasks commonly associated with humans. Overall, how worried, if at all, are you that in the next 10 years machines, computer programs, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) will take over many of the jobs done by humans?

Various human actions can be done by robots or Artificial Intelligence (AI). For each of the following, please indicate, using a scale from 0 to 10, how you would personally feel about it. On this scale, '0' means that you would feel "totally uncomfortable" and '10' means that you would feel "totally comfortable" with this situation. Being driven in a driverless car.

Various human actions can be done by robots or Artificial Intelligence (AI). For each of the following, please indicate, using a scale from 0 to 10, how you would personally feel about it. On this scale, '0' means that you would feel "totally uncomfortable" and '10' means that you would feel "totally comfortable" with this situation. Having a medical operation performed on you by a robot.
Are we spending too much, too little, or about the right amount on supporting scientific research?
